Class AbstractListParameterRenderer<E>

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.message.part.tool.param.AbstractParameterRenderer<List<E>>
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.message.part.tool.param.AbstractListParameterRenderer<E>
Type Parameters:
E - The element type of the list.
All Implemented Interfaces:
ParameterRenderer<List<E>>
Direct Known Subclasses:
TabbedListParameterRenderer, VBoxListParameterRenderer
public abstract class AbstractListParameterRenderer<E> extends AbstractParameterRenderer<List<E>>
Abstract base class for composite list and collection parameter renderers.

Manages the lifecycle of child ParameterRenderer instances, delegates incremental updateContent(List) events, and intercepts childValueChanged(ParameterRenderer, Object) to update the collection at the corresponding index and propagate changes.

      public void updateContent(List<E> newValue)

    • childValueChanged

      public void childValueChanged(ParameterRenderer<?> child, Object newChildValue)
      Notifies this renderer that one of its child renderers has changed its value. Default implementation bubbles the notification up to ParameterRenderer.getParentRenderer() if present.

      Intercepts child value changes, updates the element in the list at the corresponding index, propagates the updated list via AbstractParameterRenderer.valueChanged(Object), and triggers onChildItemUpdated(int, E).

      Parameters:
      child - The child renderer that changed.
      newChildValue - The new value emitted by the child.

    • onChildItemUpdated

      protected void onChildItemUpdated(int index, E updatedItem)
      Hook invoked when a child element at the given index has been modified. Subclasses (like TabbedListParameterRenderer) override this to update UI indicators.
      Parameters:
      index - The 0-based index of the updated item.
      updatedItem - The updated item.
